Legal.privacyDescription: Learn how DT Demenagement Tunisie collects, uses and protects your personal data.
Legal.privacyDataCollectedText: We collect only the data strictly necessary for the purposes described below:
Legal.privacyDataItem1: First and last name (quote form and client area)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem1: Process your quote request and execute the contract
Legal.privacyPurposeItem2: Log you in to your client area (Magic Link)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem3: Send you the newsletter (if you have consented)
Legal.privacyPurposeItem4: Improve our services (anonymised statistics via Google Analytics)
Legal.privacyRetentionText: Your data is kept for 3 years from the last contact. Connection logs are deleted after 12 months.
Legal.privacyRightsText: Under applicable regulations, you have the following rights:
Legal.privacyRightItem1: Right of access to your data
Legal.privacyRightItem3: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
Legal.privacyRightsContact: To exercise your rights, contact us at: {email}
Legal.privacyThirdPartyText: We do not sell or rent your data. It may be shared with our technical sub-processors (Vercel hosting, Resend/Brevo emailing) strictly within the scope of their services.
Legal.privacySecurityText: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or destruction.
Legal.cookiesDescription: Learn how DT Demenagement Tunisie uses cookies on its website.
Legal.cookiesWhatText: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website. It allows your preferences to be remembered and site usage to be analysed.
Legal.cookiesTypesIntro: This site uses the following types of cookies:
Legal.cookiesThirdPartyText: Some cookies are placed by third-party services (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel). You can consult their respective privacy policies on their official websites.
Legal.cookiesControlText: You can accept or decline non-essential cookies via the banner shown on your first visit. You can also configure your browser to block all cookies, but this may affect certain site features.
Legal.cookiesContactText: For any cookie-related questions, contact us at: {email}
